title: Burj Khalifa
summary: The Burj Khalifa is a skyscraper in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, beside the First Interchange on Sheikh Zayed Road. Guinness World Records gives its height as 828 m, with construction beginning on 21 September 2004, the exterior completed on 1 October 2009 and an official opening on 4 January 2010.

uncertainty.note: Start is the groundbreaking on 21 September 2004 (Guinness; ICC says September 2004). Exterior was completed 1 October 2009 and the tower opened 4 January 2010. End is the present.

as_recorded.value: The groundbreaking of Burj Khalifa occurred in September 2004.
